subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Which official owner should control the production GitHub OAuth App, and can that owner perform the credential rotation plus fresh web and CLI validation now?
rationale: The repository establishes the credential boundary but cannot transfer a GitHub OAuth App, read production secrets, or prove the live consent result; this requires privileged ownership and production-access judgment.

options.title: Rotate to an official OAuth App
options.body: Create or transfer the GitHub OAuth App under approved OpenClaw/ClawHub control, update production credentials, and validate fresh browser and CLI sign-in.

options.title: Document an intentional exception
options.body: If the present ownership is intentionally retained, record the accountable owner and rationale while accepting the user-trust presentation risk.

recommendation.title: Rotate to an official OAuth App
recommendation.body: Create or transfer the GitHub OAuth App under approved OpenClaw/ClawHub control, update production credentials, and validate fresh browser and CLI sign-in.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the active canonical report covering this exact production OAuth configuration concern.
